update_consolidated_keyframe: merge incremental keyframes into a consolidated keyframe by appending loads, creations, and updating state, metadata, and rig data while handling deletions
update_consolidated_message: consolidate a single user message by merging UI updates per canvas and overwriting other message fields
update_consolidated_messages: consolidate messages on a per-user basis by iterating over message lists and merging each user message
get_user_keyframe: create a new keyframe containing a user-specific message dict as the message key from a KeyframeAndMessages object
get_empty_keyframe: create an empty keyframe dictionary with initialized lists for loads, creations, stateUpdates, metadata, rigUpdates, deletions, and lights
